key_insight: A species-weighted DSMC extension can simulate weakly ionized hypersonic reacting flows while conserving mass and energy and resolving trace electrons and ions.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable prediction of communication blackout onset and ion current during atmospheric reentry, supporting vehicle design and mission safety.
method: Extend conservative species weighting to reacting DSMC with species-dependent particle weights.
Use split-merge handling for reactants/products so reactions between differently weighted species remain mass-conservative.
Validate on single-cell dissociation/exchange tests and apply to OREX reentry conditions from 105.0 to 92.8 km.
evidence_signal: The method matched conventional DSMC for mass, energy, and mole-fraction histories, and reproduced the overall trend of OREX temperature, electron-density, and ion-current data.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on reaction-rate assumptions and surface recombination modeling, especially for the uncertain N + O associative-ionization rate.
paper_title: Simulation of Weakly Ionized Hypersonic Flows with Reactive Species Weighting Scheme in the Direct Simulation Monte Carlo Method
